compute_allowance: Metadata-only complete training audit, deterministic rule tests, then bounded audio pilot if justified; no model training or official evaluation.
decision: Conservative rule and audit implemented; precision gain inconclusive until independent review. No training or incumbent promotion.
early_stop: Do not regenerate frozen manifests or scale pseudo-labeling without measured review quality.
failure_analysis: Acoustic agreement was incorrectly usable as apparent confidence in semantic labels; short listener speech alone cannot identify a backchannel.
hypothesis: The current dual-channel labeler treats every short listener utterance as a backchannel and only inspects the first listener event. This can label floor transfers as HOLD and confuses acoustic confidence with label certainty.
lessons: Inspect complete event chains and abstain on ambiguous intent; measure precision together with coverage. otoSpeech access/use scope pending.
modifications: Isolated versioned label-rule audit; compare short-event chains on existing training conversations. Add conservative abstention and report coverage instead of calling heuristic labels ground truth.
name: D012 audit and conservative multi-event pause labeling
resource_usage: CPU metadata audit and tests only; no GPU training or external benchmark
resume: See research/DATA_STRATEGY.md; inspect review_queue.jsonl. Do not regenerate frozen manifests.
success_criteria: Expose reproducible contradictory event chains; pass semantic edge-case tests and causal crop checks. Quality improvement needs independent reviewed labels, not agreement with the same rules.
